source: Exported from the MIA Notion calendar on 2026-10-20, then researched and verified on official pages.

items.name: Lagos Leadership Summit
items.venue: Not stated on fetched page (organiser address is Alausa, Ikeja)
items.description: A summit aimed at redefining leadership through inclusivity and innovation.
items.notes: Last verified edition April 16-17, 2025. No 2026 or 2027 edition found on the site.

items.name: Africa Startup Festival
items.venue: Balmoral Convention Center, Federal Palace, Ikoyi/Victoria Island (per page JSON-LD, which still carries 2024 dates)
items.description: A premier gathering recognized as Africa's top deal-making and networking event, bringing together investors, founders, and operators.
items.notes: Last edition date is the page title ('Lagos | November 28, 2025'). Page banner says 'ASF Lagos isn't live' and points to an ASF Kenya edition; the ticket page says ASF 2026 tickets 'go live soon' with no date. Next edition date not published.

items.name: No Code Tech Summit (NCTS)
items.description: An annual event dedicated to connecting and inspiring professionals in the no-code space by highlights the growing significance of non-coding roles within the tech ecosystem and providing a platform for individuals to learn, network, and contribute to the industry’s development.
items.notes: NCTS Legacy 3.0 on 21 Feb 2026. Venue not on the fetched text. Next edition not announced.

items.name: MarTech Africa
items.description: This event will focus on conversations around Acquisition, Engagement and Retention, essential aspects of today’s competitive marketing landscape.
items.notes: MarTech Africa 3.0, online, Saturday 28 Feb 2026 9AM WAT, marked 'Event ended'. Notion date 2026-02-26 is wrong. Eventbrite is the only official page found. Next edition not announced.

items.name: APIConf Lagos
items.description: A conference promoting API literacy among developers, featuring networking and workshops.
items.notes: The 2026 edition ran 24 to 25 July at The Zone, Gbagada (Sessionize, Luma). apiconf.net stopped answering in October 2026, so the link is the organisers' Luma page. The next edition's call for speakers usually opens on Sessionize in January.

items.name: MoonShot by TechCabal
items.venue: National Theatre (Wole Soyinka Centre for Culture and Creative Arts)
items.description: A two-day event featuring startup pitches, fireside chats, masterclasses, and networking opportunities.
items.notes: Theme 'Courage & Conviction'. Previous edition 15-16 Oct 2025 (same page). Starts in 8 days.

items.name: Search Africon
items.description: A conference advancing SEO and digital marketing in Africa, featuring expert talks, workshops, and networking.
items.notes: Next edition is the Kenya edition on 7 Nov 2026 (city and venue not stated in the header). The Lagos edition last ran 29 May 2026 (in-person, live virtual workshop the day before). Site also mentions a 2027 edition with no date.

items.name: Web Summit
items.description: Large global tech conference with founders, investors and marketers in Lisbon.
items.notes: Global.

items.name: DevFest Lagos
items.description: A developer festival organized by GDG Lagos, featuring tech talks and networking.
items.notes: 14th edition, in-person, early-bird tickets live (standard single day NGN 8,000). Venue not published on the page. Previous edition 2025 site at /2025 loads but dates not extracted.

items.name: Growth Africa Summit
items.description: An annual summit that brings together founders, growth professionals, investors, and ecosystem actors across Africa to explore scaling strategies, growth frameworks, networking, and applied sessions (growth labs, revenue design, building growth systems).
items.notes: Third edition (GAS 3.0). Date is in page JSON-LD and body. Venue not published. Doors 9:00am.

items.name: Africa Tech Festival
items.description: Telecoms, AI, cybersecurity, startups and digital transformation show in Cape Town.
items.notes: Organiser not named in the fetched text.

items.name: Entertainment Week Africa
items.description: Six days of summits, markets and showcases across music, film, fashion, tech and creative business in Lagos.
items.notes: Dates in page JSON-LD. Venue not published on the page. Creator-economy and creative-business angle.

items.name: Africa Fintech Summit Kigali
items.description: 16th edition of the pan-African fintech summit for regulators, founders and investors, with a pitch competition.
items.notes: Date from the organiser's own press release (18-19 Nov); some listings say 18-20 Nov. The summit pages are JavaScript-rendered so venue could not be read; search coverage says Kigali Convention Centre (unverified).

items.name: Slush
items.description: Founder-focused startup event in Helsinki.
items.notes: Global.

items.name: ADMARP Digital Product Growth Summit
items.description: One-day free summit for marketing, product and growth teams with the first Digital Product Growth Awards.
items.notes: Free, registration required, 9:00am to 5:30pm, about 1,000 in-person capacity.

items.name: LAIF Awards (Lagos Advertising and Ideas Festival)
items.organiser: Association of Advertising Agencies of Nigeria (AAAN), per press coverage
items.description: Nigeria's main advertising and creative awards festival, 21st edition, themed 'Glitch to Great'.
items.notes: The awards run 27 to 28 November 2026, inside a festival week from 23 November, per AAAN's announcement in the trade press (BrandCom, Brandspur). laif.com.ng refuses scripts, so the date is checked on the BrandCom report.

items.name: Art of Technology Lagos (AOT Lagos)
items.description: One-day Lagos conference on tech adoption, ethics and governance for startups, investors and policymakers.
items.notes: Aggregator startupmaphub shows 4 Dec; the official site says Thursday 3 Dec 2026, 9am to 5pm.

items.name: Africa Tech Summit Nairobi
items.description: Tech corporates, investors, startups, fintech and climate leaders meet in Nairobi.
items.notes: Dates from page JSON-LD. Search coverage says Sarit Expo Centre (not confirmed on the fetched page).

items.name: Lagos Tech Fest
items.venue: Landmark Event Centre, Victoria Island (main day); Civic Centre and other venues for side events
items.description: An annual technology conference that brings together startup founders, tech leaders, investors, government representatives, and innovators across Africa to discuss digital transformation, fintech, AI, Web3, and enterprise technology while fostering collaboration and policy dialogue for ecosystem growth.
items.notes: 7th edition. Previous edition Lagos Tech Fest 2026 (2,950+ attendees per site recap; exact dates not on the page). Organiser name taken from the eventhive.ng domain.

items.name: Tech Revolution Africa
items.description: Tech Revolution Africa Conference and Exhibition 2026, themed “The Big Bold Step,” brings together founders, startups, investors, creators, innovators, enterprises, policy makers, and government representatives for two days of keynotes, fireside chats, panels, executive chats, mixers, and deal-making conversations. Headlined by MTN, with an expected audience of 5,000+ participants.
items.notes: Tech Revolution Africa 3.0, theme 'Built to Last', early-bird tickets live. The Notion link (eventpadi checkout, JS-rendered) and techrevolutionafrica.com are not the live site; the real site is techrevolutionafrica.org. Last edition: Notion says 30-31 Jan 2026 (Landmark), not confirmed on a fetched page. Aggregator startupmaphub shows 2027-01-28, which is wrong.

items.name: SXSW
items.description: Tech, film and music festival and conference in Austin.
items.notes: Global.

items.name: Tech Unite Africa
items.description: A one-day summit focusing on innovation and collaboration among tech professionals, entrepreneurs, and creatives.
items.notes: T.U.A 2027, co-located with NETCON 2027 and Startup World Cup Nigeria. Dates are in the page title and meta description.

items.name: IoT West Africa + Data Center & Cloud Expo Africa
items.description: A major exhibition focusing on IoT innovations, data centers, and cloud technologies in West Africa.
items.notes: Co-located with Data Center & Cloud Expo Africa. Previous edition was April 2026 per the site header. Organiser name not confirmed on the page.

items.name: GITEX Africa
items.description: Large Africa tech and startup show in Marrakech covering AI, cloud, cybersecurity, fintech and agritech.
items.notes: Venue not in fetched text; organiser not named.

items.name: SaaStr AI Annual
items.description: B2B SaaS and AI conference with CMO, CRO and CCO summits.
items.notes: Global. Site calls the location San Francisco Bay.

items.name: AI Everything Kenya x GITEX Kenya
items.description: AI summit and tech expo in Nairobi.
items.notes: Dates from page JSON-LD. Page text references KICC for the 2026 edition; 2027 venue not confirmed.

items.name: Web Summit Vancouver
items.description: North American Web Summit edition (formerly Collision).
items.notes: Global. collisionconf.com redirects here.

items.name: VivaTech
items.description: Large European startup and tech event in Paris.
items.notes: Global.

items.name: Africa Technology Expo
items.description: An expo showcasing the latest technological advancements and startups in Africa.
items.notes: 2027 date is in the page header; tickets for 2027 not yet live (register-interest only). The 2026 edition ran earlier in 2026, but its exact dates are not on the fetched pages (secondary news search suggested late June 2026; unverified). Search-engine snapshots of the ticket and schedule pages showed 25-26 June 2027, but the live fetch on 2026-10-20 shows 17-19 June 2027 on the header, ticket page and FAQ; recheck before publishing. Live site says 17-19 June 2027; older search snapshots said 25-26 June. Weekly upkeep rechecks.

items.name: Cannes Lions
items.description: The main international festival of creativity for brands, agencies and marketers.
items.notes: Global.

items.name: UNBOUND (formerly INBOUND)
items.description: HubSpot's annual go-to-market conference, rebranded from INBOUND to UNBOUND.
items.notes: Global. inbound.com now redirects to unbound.hubspot.com. 2026 edition was Boston, 16-18 Sep. Presale sold out.

items.name: GITEX Nigeria
items.venue: Landmark Centre (Lagos expo); Abuja hosts a government and AI summit day
items.description: A major tech event exploring Nigeria's vast tech ecosystem, featuring global tech communities.
items.notes: Most recent edition: 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-03 (Abuja then Lagos). Next edition: page title, meta and JSON-LD say 5-7 October 2027, but body text on the same page says 28-30 Sep 2027. Conflict on the official page; recheck before publishing.

items.name: DigiMarCon Africa
items.venue: V&A Waterfront, Africa Avenue conference venue
items.description: Two-day digital marketing, media and advertising conference and exhibition in Cape Town.
items.notes: Page JSON-LD still carries 2024 dates; title and body say 6-7 Oct 2027. DigiMarCon's own events index lists South African dates in late Sep 2027, so recheck before publishing.

items.name: Abuja Startup Expo
items.description: A premier gathering for innovators in Abuja's startup ecosystem, featuring exhibitions and networking.
items.notes: abujastartupexpo.ng does not resolve (DNS failure on 2026-10-20). Notion date 2026-02-28 could not be verified on any fetched page. No official site found by search.

items.name: Africa Revenue Makers Awards (ARMA)
items.description: A Pan-African virtual awards event that celebrates and recognizes outstanding professionals driving business growth and revenue across sales, marketing, and customer success roles.
items.notes: b4b.partners redirects to b4bpartners.com. The /ARMA/ page now loads a generic consulting homepage with no ARMA content or dates. Treat as unknown until the organiser republishes.

items.name: African Product Marketing Pioneers (APMP)
items.description: A pan-African community for product marketers, APMP connects, upskills, and recognizes African brand builders. Through webinars, resources, and an annual Marketing Leaders Index, it empowers marketers to scale products, craft compelling go-to-market strategies, and grow their professional influence across the continent.
items.notes: Site loads. Events page shows a generic '2025 Calendar' of meetups/webinars with no dated flagship summit and reads like template copy. No verifiable dated edition.

items.name: AfricArena Lagos Summit
items.description: A one-day event featuring startup pitches from across Africa within the Fintech and Mobility sectors.
items.notes: Site loads. No Lagos summit is listed. The 2026 tour shows Nairobi and Kinshasa summits, and the 10th anniversary Grand Summit 2026 is in Cape Town (venue and exact date not extractable from the fetched page). Lagos edition appears dropped.

items.name: Lagos Executive Cloud Tech Summit
items.description: A tech conference on cloud innovation and digital transformation, featuring expert panels and networking.
items.notes: No official page, date or press coverage exists for this summit, and Cecure Intelligence's events page lists none, so it is marked discontinued.

items.name: Lagos Startup Expo
items.description: A large-scale exhibition and networking event that connects startups, investors, and innovators to showcase products, attract funding, and explore business partnerships through exhibitions, masterclasses, and investor lounges focused on practical engagement and deal-making.
items.notes: Notion link is a Techpoint article that returns 403 to scripts. Search coverage (not fetched, so not used for dates) indicates Lagos Startup Expo 2.0 ran 18-19 June 2025 at Landmark Centre. No official event site found and no 2026/2027 edition found.

items.name: Lagos Startup Week
items.description: A week-long event bringing together startups, investors, and tech enthusiasts for discussions and networking.
items.notes: Site loads, headline reads '2026 - Lagos, Nigeria' (title still says 2025) but no start or end date or venue is published. Treat as date TBA.

items.name: Marketing & Chill
items.description: Marketing & Chill is a relaxed, community-led gathering for marketers to connect, share experiences, and have informal conversations around marketing, growth, and careers.
items.notes: MIA's own Luma calendar loads and shows no upcoming event. The Notion date 2026-10-31 is not on any fetched page (the Luma Lagos discover feed lists no Marketing & Chill either). Confirm in-house.

items.name: Nigeria Fintech Week
items.description: The largest gathering of fintech stakeholders in Nigeria.
items.notes: The ninth edition ran 22 to 23 September 2026 in Lagos (Wole Soyinka Centre), Abuja and Port Harcourt (TechNext24, BusinessDay). nigeriafintechweek.org does not answer, so the link is FintechNGR's own site, which hosts the event.

items.name: Product Dive Conference
items.description: Nigeria’s leading product management and tech innovation conference.
items.notes: Site returns 403 to curl but loads via WebFetch. It says ProductDive holds a major conference yearly, and its home page references The DIVE editions, but gives no dates or venue. Search coverage (not fetched) says The DIVE 2025 was 10 Dec 2025 at Landmark Event Centre, Lagos. No 2026/2027 date published.

items.name: Revup Africa
items.organiser: B4B Partners and RevStar Community (per search coverage)
items.description: A premier one-day conference for revenue professionals across Africa bringing together sales, marketing, product, customer success and RevOps leaders to align strategy, share growth playbooks and build a connected revenue ecosystem.
items.notes: The last edition found ran 6 September 2025 at The Zone, Gbagada (TechCabal). No 2026 edition was announced and revup.africa stopped answering in October 2026, so it is marked discontinued. A new edition found by the Events Watch would bring it back.

items.name: The Builders Summit by Founders Connect
items.description: A one-day summit focusing on innovation and collaboration among tech professionals, entrepreneurs, and creatives.
items.notes: Notion URL /tbs2025 returns 404. Events page lists The Builders Summit 2024 (1,154 attendees) and 2025 (1,427) and a 2026 Founders Connect Live show, with no dates or a 2026/2027 summit.
